Our treatments

Specialist care for every part of your smile

See all treatments

Implant dentistry

Replace missing teeth with a permanent, natural-looking fix.

Periodontics

Diagnosis and treatment of gum disease to keep teeth secure.

Prosthodontics

Crowns, bridges and dentures that restore function and appearance.

Endodontics

Precise root canal treatment to save a painful or infected tooth.

Oral surgery

Wisdom teeth, complex extractions and surgical procedures.

Paediatric dentistry

Gentle, patient care designed around children.

Since 2013, Limerick's first multi-disciplinary referral practice, so your specialists plan your care together, under one roof.
